requirements_summary: Primary requirement: deterministic tail latency for chat assistant and reranking pipeline. Targets discussed: p50/p95/p99 split for both non-streaming and streaming flows. Non-streaming (single request -> full response, up to 256 tokens): target p50 35-50ms, p95 <120ms, p99 <250ms. Streaming: first-token SLO target p50 <20ms, p95 <80ms; full-response p95 negotiated against token-length buckets (e.g., <=32 tokens p95 <150ms, <=128 tokens p95 <400ms). Need per-token throughput characterization and per-route SLOs. Measurement alignment: require explicit definition of measurement boundary (client SDK start vs Redwood ingress vs model compute start), include network hop instrumentation, and agree on clock sync approach (NTP/traceparent).
